title: Technology and Social Connection
prompt:
In your English class you have been talking about how technology affects the way people interact with each other. Your teacher has asked you to write an essay for homework, giving your opinion on the following statement, using the notes below to help you.

'Technology brings people together more than it keeps them apart.'

Notes
- Social media and messaging
- Face-to-face relationships
- Working from home

Write an essay discussing TWO of the points in the notes. You should explain which point you think is more important in relation to the statement, giving reasons to support your opinion. You may, if you wish, make use of the notes provided, but you should use your own ideas as far as possible.
notes: Look for: a clear, well-organised introduction that restates the issue without copying the prompt; two body paragraphs each developing one of the chosen points with specific reasoning (not just assertion); an explicit comparison of which point matters more, not just two parallel lists; a conclusion that reaches a reasoned opinion; a good range of linking devices and C1-level vocabulary around technology/relationships rather than repeating simple words like 'good'/'bad'.
